title: Quasar runtime-compatibility boundary map
description: Schema for config/quasar/runtime-compatibility.json — the per-file static compatibility boundary for Quasar demo mode, enforced by scripts/check-quasar-runtime-compatibility.mjs. The same file is also the Quasar lane's fingerprint selector: scripts/lib/surfpool-evidence-manifest.mjs reads it under a descriptor-bound contract and folds the paths it lists into the lane source fingerprint. This schema constrains only what is decidable from the document text; the selector remains the authoritative check for everything that depends on filesystem state.

path.description: Repository-relative POSIX path, already normalized. The pattern rejects everything the fingerprint selector can refuse on text alone: an empty value, a leading slash, a Windows drive prefix or any backslash (so UNC forms are excluded too), an empty segment from a doubled or trailing slash, and any '.' or '..' segment. It deliberately stops there — JSON Schema cannot observe the filesystem, so the selector in scripts/lib/surfpool-evidence-manifest.mjs stays the authoritative check that the path exists, resolves inside the repository, is an ordinary file or directory, and does not traverse a symbolic link. A path that satisfies this pattern can still be refused there; nothing is normalized on the selector's behalf.
